name: Leyla
description: As a child, Leyla suffers a blow from her stepmother and sees her world turned upside down. She loses everything - except the thirst for revenge. In search of justice, Leyla transforms into someone else and returns determined to settle accounts with the woman who destroyed her life and left her in a garbage dump. However, her revenge falters when she discovers the relationship between her ex-stepmother and the man, with whom she shared an innocent and unforgettable love affair

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Losing her mother at a young age and having no one but her father, Leyla's life is turned upside down when her father remarries. After losing her beloved father due to the cruelty of her ruthless stepmother, Nur, Leyla is abandoned in a dump by Nur and her lover, Mali. As Nur and Mali continue to deceive people to sustain their lives, their next victim is Tufo. After enduring many challenges in the dump, Leyla returns years later to take revenge on Nur.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Leyla is deeply shaken when she recognizes Cino, whom she thought was dead for years, from his scar and goes to confront Güzide. No matter how much Güzide warns Leyla to stay away from Nur and Civan, Leyla has already sworn revenge. She accepts Nur's offer to work as a cook in their house. Civan is very confused about Leyla and while he tells her about his childhood love from years ago that he can't forget, Neco appears before Nur and Mali after many years.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Nur's plan continues to unfold smoothly after Serap catches Tufo and Nur at home and leaves Tufo. While Leyla and Cino experience fear about what might happen to them after being locked in a warehouse, Cino is released first. Facing Nur, Leyla is about to start a new chapter in her life. Tufo is forced to explain everything that has happened to his family. When Nur and Mali come face to face with Neco after many years, they are shocked, and Neco's words, "Leyla is alive," cause tension between the two, leading them to investigate further. Upon learning of the situation, Güzide immediately warns Leyla.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the past, Güzide's plan to protect both Cino and Leyla has led to a new life for both children. Tufo, who falls into Nur's trap each time, decides to marry Nur and ends up living the new life that Nur has orchestrated. Upon suspecting Leyla, Nur devises a new plan. Drawing inspiration from a sentence created by Civan, Leyla prepares a surprise for him that will make him happy.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Leyla is under the influence of the closeness she experienced with Civan. While love on one side and revenge on the other are pressuring her, Civan is also in the process of choosing between Leyla and Ceren. On the other hand, while the surprise event that happened between Nur and Serap at the beauty center brings the two face to face, this situation also causes tension between Nur and Ferda. While Leyla does not hesitate to use this tension against Nur, she will make her real move at the historical artifact auction she went to with Nur.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Learning that Leyla is alive, Civan is determined to find his childhood love. Someone he never expected will help Civan on this journey. For Nur, finding Leyla becomes a matter of life and death. Güzide is forced to make a choice with the threat of Nur, who wants to learn the truth.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While Leyla wants to reveal the secret between Nur and Mali, she also risks her own secret. After the eventful night, a turning point occurs in the lives of Ferda and Mali. While Leyla continues her revenge plan, she continues to get closer to Civan. When Leyla goes to her childhood home with Civan, she is unaware of the surprise that awaits her.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Leyla is excited about her love affair with Civan. Civan decides to tell his family about his decision to leave Ceren. On the other hand, Nur is cornered after Melih's blackmail. Nur, who makes a surprise move to prevent Civan and Ceren from breaking up, surprises everyone, while Leyla will have to choose between her love and revenge.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Leyla and Civan's escape plan is foiled by a surprise event. Nur makes a shocking move to get out of the situation she is in. Civan gets depressed as he gets stuck between Nur and Leyla and throws himself in the trash. Leyla starts to take revenge again with the recent events and the new information she has learned. The bomb that Leyla will detonate in the middle of the house will be the beginning of a new era where nothing will be the same.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Leyla ensures that the family learns the truth about ipek. Meanwhile, she is forced to confront a secret she never knew. To calm the family's anger, Nur collaborates with both Melih and a mysterious journalist. The tension Tufan experiences with Nur leads to a closer connection with Serap, while the meal Nur organizes for the children at the dump brings everyone together. In the tense finale, where the tension never drops, Leyla, trying to keep her identity hidden, unexpectedly comes face to face with the person who unravels her secret.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Leyla is cornered by Neco's threat to reveal her identity. Nur manages to bring the family back under control with the pressure put on Tufan by the journalist. Civan starts a dangerous journey to get out of the depression he is in. On the other hand, Serap has a big dilemma before marriage because of her feelings for Tufan. While Nur is looking for a way to get rid of Serap, he is also trying to harm Ferda, who is pregnant.  In the grand finale, where the tension is at its peak, Leyla faces the trap set by Nur while trying to reach Civan, while Civan will come face to face with death.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Leyla experiences another shock with the arrival of a surprise guest, just as she is trying to recover from falling into Nur's trap. Meanwhile, Civan starts to follow the trail of his real mother, based on memories from his childhood. Civan's surprise offer to Neco astonishes the whole family, especially Nur and Mali. While journalist Rasim's blackmail regarding the past corners Nur, the mysterious guest Leyla invites to the house will change all the dynamics.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Leyla faces trouble after Rasim's surprise move. Tufan plans to confess to protect family. Nur's risky offer forces Leyla's tough choice. Civan finds clue of biological mother. Finale: Leyla's move leads to Civan vs Nur confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Civan reveals the truth about Nur's motherhood, confronting her in front of the whole family. Nur's confession leaves everyone, especially Mali, in disbelief. The ripple effects of Nur's revelations begin to unfold.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Although Leyla saves Ferda's life, she is targeted by Nur. While Nur makes moves to send Leyla away from the house, she also tries to repair her relationship with Civan. Meanwhile, Arzu, who wants to be on the cover of the society magazine's new year edition, faces a surprise from Nur. As the countdown to New Year's begins, the decision made by Tufan astonishes everyone, especially Nur, while Civan's suspicions about Leyla will open the door to the truth.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Leyla explains to Civan who she is and that she has come to take revenge on his mother. Civan is torn between his love and his mother. He takes action to save both himself and Leyla from this situation. Meanwhile, Nur is in a difficult position after Tufan's shocking decision. While Nur makes a surprising move to avoid leaving the house, Tufan is forced to face the secret Serap has been hiding until now. In the finale, where excitement reaches its peak, Leyla takes another step closer to her revenge, while Civan is about to learn a big truth about himself.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Leyla is on the verge of losing Civan's trust. Disappointed by the truths he has learned, Civan gives Nur and Mali time to confess their secrets while also pressuring Leyla to reveal her true identity. Cornered, Leyla makes a secret deal for revenge against Nur; meanwhile, Nur makes a dangerous deal to prevent Tufan and Serap's romance. The surprising development in the breath-taking grand finale will turn all balances upside down.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Leyla moves to the confrontation phase in her revenge plan. While Nur tries to figure out who Ela Karaca is, she is shocked to see Hilmi's little daughter Leyla in front of her. As Leyla struggles to take revenge on Nur, she also strives to preserve the purity of her love with Civan. The showdown that occurs at the peak of tension in the episode finale will ignite the fuse for the war that is about to begin.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After the confrontation they experienced, Leyla and Nur begin to play their cards openly. In her revenge game, Leyla makes moves to ensure that Nur is left alone. While Nur tries to form alliances against Leyla, she also searches for a way to corner Tufan, who wants to divorce her. Mali is forced to choose between Nur and Leyla. Civan worried that Leyla would become like Nur due to her vengeance, prepares a program with a surprise ending for her. The excitement reaches its peak when Nur makes a dangerous move to send Leyla out of the house; Civan and Leyla's unexpected move will astonish everyone, especially Nur.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Leyla returns to the mansion after marrying Civan. Civan tries to ensure that Leyla does not ruin both herself and their love due to her feelings of revenge. However, Leyla thwarts Civan's efforts by bringing Nur's mother, Nermin, to the mansion. Nur devises a dangerous plan to sabotage Leyla and Civan's wedding. In the suspenseful finale, the surprising move Leyla makes against Nur will turn everything upside down.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Leyla manages to take revenge on Nur on her happiest day. Nur, on the other hand, is forced to confront her prison phobia, which she has been avoiding since her childhood. Civan, who faces the truth that Leyla has been hiding from him, has to make a choice between Nur and Leyla. In the finale where excitement reaches its peak, Nur will shock everyone, especially Leyla, with her statement.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Leyla takes action, believing that Nur's pregnancy is a ruse. At Leyla's prompting, Tufan requests a DNA test from Nur. Following these events, Nur becomes a tabloid figure. Meanwhile, Civan is shocked by the big secret Leyla reveals. The tension-filled finale, where Nur and Leyla confront each other, will feature a surprising development that will astonish everyone.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Leyla falls into a very difficult situation with the trap set for her by Nur. Nur manages to convince everyone that Leyla tried to kill her baby. Civan and Leyla come face to face for the first time since their marriage. Leyla, who is forced to leave the mansion, takes action to prove her innocence. Nur's mother Nermin has the footage that will save Leyla. Nermin has one condition to give the footage to Leyla. In the finale where excitement reaches its peak, Leyla tries to get the footage from Nermin on the one hand, and on the other hand, she prepares a trap that will make Nur pay for what she did.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Leyla reveals her true identity in front of the Yıldız Family. Nur and Mali, whose past secrets are revealed one by one, now have only one chance: to get rid of Leyla completely. Nur, who is left penniless, manages to return to the association despite the scandal she has experienced. Leyla enters the association to prevent Nur's big plans and they meet here. Mali learns that Nur killed her baby. Nur, who makes plans to eliminate Leyla, finds herself in a trap that will lead her to death step by step.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Leyla doesn't slow down after revealing her identity to the Yıldız Family. First, she tells Serap about what happened in the past. Serap leaves Tufan. Tufan, who is devastated, is exactly the opportunity Nur is looking for. Nur finally convinces Tufan, Leyla will never stop without destroying their family. As a result, Tufan and Selman decide to get rid of the Leyla issue completely. And for the first time, Leyla feels that she could be killed. Civan is always there to protect Leyla. Thinking that Tufan is up to something, Civan keeps an eye on the family. This causes his ties with his father to become more strained than ever. Meanwhile, Leyla learns the secret of the "Hereke Carpet" from Güzide and tells it to Nur. Neco is the one who caused Nur to live a miserable life without a father. Wanting revenge, Nur asks Mali to kill her father Neco. However, Nur encounters an unexpected surprise that will shake all the balances in the finale.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Leyla takes action to find out what Mali is threatening Nur with. Nur makes a surprise offer to Güzide to eliminate the images in Mali. On the other hand, Tufan, who is cornered by the deadline given to him by Leyla, puts the plan he made with Takoz into action. In the finale where excitement reaches its peak, Civan races against time to break the trap set against Leyla, while Leyla will walk towards death step by step.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After receiving the news of Leyla's death, Nur's next plan is to seize the deeds. Civan takes action to avenge Leyla. The Yıldız family, shaken by the news that Tufan killed Leyla, is shocked when the police take Tufan into custody. Nur, who made her final move by kicking the Yıldız family out of the mansion, encounters a big surprise on her birthday. In the finale where tension will peak, the garbage dump, which is the beginning of the whole story, will host its new guest.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: After sending Nur to the junkyard, Leyla increases the pressure on Tufan to turn himself in. The decision that Civan—who knows the truth—will make has the potential to shift all the balances. Civan will have to choose between saving his mother, Nur, or the man he sees as a father, Tufan. Meanwhile, Nur, desperately trying to escape the junkyard, must overcome the obstacle that is Leyla. In a heart-pounding finale, Leyla learns that Nur is the one who killed her father—sending her into a frenzy and driving her to grab her gun in a quest for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: As Leyla attempts to kill Nur, she is met with a shocking turn of events. In the junkyard, Nur fights for her life—more alone than ever before. But the most devastating blow for Leyla comes with the unexpected death of her mother, Sema. In her most desperate moment, it’s her brother Civan and sister İpek who reignite Leyla’s will to live. In a finale filled with heart-pounding tension, Nur’s fate rests in Leyla’s hands—just as Leyla’s love becomes the key to Nur’s destiny.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Leyla needs Nur and Mali to save Civan. Nur and Mali start to act together with Leyla against Civan's illness. Everyone mobilizes by donating blood to save Civan. In the finale where tension will reach its peak, Tufan's move, who faces the secret of his life, will determine both his own fate and Civan's fate.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Leyla experiences a great shock while trying to kill Nur. Nur is more alone than ever in her life-and-death battle at the garbage dump. The surprise development that will deeply hurt Leyla is the unexpected death of her mother Sema. In Leyla's most desperate time, Civan and her sister İpek give her the joy of living. In the finale where the excitement reaches its peak, Nur's fate depends on Leyla, and Leyla's love depends on Nur's fate.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: After Nur and Mali are caught, Leyla must choose between love or revenge. On the other hand, the Yıldız family is stuck between Nur and Mali's forbidden love and Civan's life. Nur makes a dangerous plan to get rid of Neco, who she learned will be Civan's donor. In the breathtaking finale, the truth that Civan will learn will upset all the balances.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Civan has forgotten the bad events he experienced in the last seven months of his life and the bitter truths he learned. Leyla is torn between whether to tell the truths Civan has forgotten or not. While Nur breathes a sigh of relief when Civan loses his memory, she once...

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Civan overcomes his memory loss and confronts the truths he forgot. Leyla makes the Yıldız family pay for Civan remembering everything. While Hatice and Ferda's secret shatters the Yıldız family, the truth about Tufan will surprise everyone. When Nur goes to the mansion where her father once lived, she finds a surprise name in front of her. Mali is sure that Nur is the one who killed Neco. In the breathtaking finale, Mali draws Nur into a deadly trap, while Civan, who cannot stand what he has experienced, will be shocked by the truth that Leyla shouts.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Civan's illness entering its final stages deeply shakes everyone. Nur receives an offer from her sister Handan, who enters her life after many years, to save Civan. While Nur accepts this dangerous offer, Leyla is the one who will help her. In the episode finale where tension will reach its peak, Nur and Leyla fight shoulder to shoulder to save Civan, unexpected farewells and surprising separations will come one after another.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After the separation at Yıldız Mansion, the lives of Leyla, Nur, and Mali intersect once again—this time at Köroğlu Mansion. With a new story and a new role, Nur starts working at Köroğlu Mansion as the assistant to the housekeeper. The family is unaware of her true identity and real purpose. While Nur tries to get to know the colorful and mysterious family members, she also struggles with the blackmail attempts of Leyla and Mali. Mali pressures Nur to let him into the mansion, while Leyla confronts her in order to protect Eren, a family member she met on a flight. When Leyla learns who Eren really is—and how his mother Handan died—she is shocked.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Although Nur saves Vedat from death, she still cannot escape being the prime suspect. Vedat Köroğlu gives his children 24 hours to find out who tried to kill him. Meanwhile, preparations are underway at Köroğlu Mansion to celebrate Vedat’s 70th birthday. While Dilara plans a surprise party for her father, her siblings Suat and Ahsen oppose the idea. Nur, on one hand, tries to sabotage the birthday party, while on the other hand, she must deal with Leyla’s increasing pressure. Realizing that Eren is considered an unwanted person within the Köroğlu family, Nur takes action by using the growing closeness between Leyla and Eren to her advantage. Nur will be confronted with a truth that will leave her completely shocked.
